title: Polynomial-time unary output
statement: For all natural numbers $C$ and $e$, the function sending each bit string $x$ to the word consisting of exactly $C(|x|+1)^e$ copies of the bit $1$ is polynomial-time computable.
replaced: For all constants $C$ and $e$, the function sending a string $x$ to the word of exactly $C(|x|+1)^e$ true bits is polynomial-time computable, including the zero-coefficient and zero-degree cases; the exact value is never replaced by a majorant.
